# MIA OS: requirements traceability matrix (Prompt 04, deliverable 11)

*Generated by `python -m tools.requirements_matrix` from the requirement tables; don't edit by hand. `tests/test_requirements_spec.py` fails when it's out of date or a row is malformed. Fields are explained in [MIA_OS_SYSTEM_REQUIREMENTS.md](MIA_OS_SYSTEM_REQUIREMENTS.md) §1.*

**371 requirements.** Exists: 145; Partial: 120; Planned: 28; New: 78. MVP: 204; R1: 159; Mature: 7; Later: 1.

**By owner prompt:** 05 (21), 06 (18), 07 (74), 08 (64), 09 (26), 10 (74), 11 (36), 12 (36), 13 (49), 14 (40), 15 (14), 16 (3), 17 (1), all (1).

## The MVP's remaining work (Must · MVP, not yet built)

| ID | Requirement | Status | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-ARC-001 | MIA OS shall be built on an unmodified upstream Linux kernel and a mainstream distribution base; no custom kernel or distribution is maintained. | Planned | 05, 06 |
| REQ-ARC-002 | The operating system layer shall not depend on the MIA platform: the machine boots, logs in and runs conventional apps with the MIA Runtime stopped or absent. | New | 05, 14 |
| REQ-ARC-003 | The MIA platform (engine, stores, capabilities, action contract) shall run unchanged on Windows, Linux, Android and Raspberry Pi OS; OS-specific code sits behind interfaces. | Partial: runs on all four today; OS-level services not yet behind an interface | 05, 12 |
| REQ-ARC-004 | One long-running MIA Runtime per person shall own their stores, schedule their jobs and serve every surface; surfaces hold no business logic. | Partial: `core/runtime.py` exists; the desktop app still hosts it on Windows | 05, 14 |
| REQ-ARC-010 | Privileged system changes (packages, services, firmware, users) shall go only through a narrow helper with fixed operations; the runtime itself runs unprivileged. | Planned (DEC-0158) | 05, 13 |
| REQ-ARC-011 | The OS image shall be built from files in the repository, signed, and updated atomically with rollback to the previous deployment. | Planned (DEC-0157) | 14, 15 |
| REQ-ARC-013 | Conventional Linux applications shall be installed and updated by the OS's own mechanisms (Flatpak, the image), never by MIA's registry; MIA-native apps never depend on Flatpak. | Planned | 05, 10 |
| REQ-FUN-001 | The PC shall offer at least two sessions at login, MIA's and a conventional desktop (KDE Plasma), each usable without the other running. | Planned | 05, 10 |
| REQ-FUN-002 | Authentication shall use the OS's login (PAM), with the disk unlocked before it; MIA's own sign-in stays a person selector inside her session, never a second password for the machine. | Planned | 13, 14 |
| REQ-FUN-003 | Settings shall be split: system settings (display, network, users, updates) in the OS's settings app and reachable from MIA's; MIA's settings in her Settings app; each reachable by voice and screen. | Partial: MIA's Settings exist; system settings not reachable from her | 10 |
| REQ-FUN-010 | Diagnostics shall show the runtime's health, each job's record, each app's status, the Fix-It Log, disk, memory and model status, without the model. | Partial: Diagnostics, `/api/runtime/health`, statuses; no single page with all | 14 |
| REQ-FUN-041 | Apps shall share data only through capabilities, events, links and the history; no app reads another's store directly. | Partial: true of the code's layering; not enforced per app until code moves (M6) | 05 |

| REQ-FUN-202 | A terminal, an editor, git and the Python toolchain shall be available in the conventional session without MIA. | Planned (in the image) | 15 |
| REQ-FUN-221 | An answer built from several stores shall name which parts it couldn't read, rather than leaving them out silently. | Partial | 07 |
| REQ-FUN-222 | Every recommendation shall be marked as MIA's, separately from the facts it rests on. | Partial (Living System invariant; not every surface) | 07 |
| REQ-AI-013 | When the chosen model fails or times out, MIA shall fall back to the next local one and say which answered. | Partial (`home_link` says which level answered) | 07 |
| REQ-SEC-001 | The PC's disk shall be encrypted (LUKS2), unlocked at boot by the TPM plus a PIN; the phone keeps Android's encryption. | Planned (DEC-0157) | 13, 14 |
| REQ-SEC-003 | Every capability shall run with least privilege: the runtime as the person's unprivileged user, extensions sandboxed, system changes through the helper only. | Partial: tiers and grants exist; helper and sandbox planned | 13 |
| REQ-SEC-004 | The runtime's local API shall accept only authenticated callers (the person's sessions and paired devices); nothing listens on a public interface by default. | Partial: pairing tokens for the phone; review needed for the image | 12, 13 |
| REQ-PER-002 | The conventional desktop shall be usable within 10 s of choosing it at login, with MIA's runtime still starting or failed. *(provisional)* | New | 10, 14 |
| REQ-CMP-002 | Existing data shall carry over to the Linux image with nothing lost (stores, history, sealed files re-sealed under the new key). | Planned | 16 |
| REQ-CMP-003 | Ordinary Linux GUI apps (Flatpak) and Windows-only needs shall be listed before the switch, each with its Linux answer or a reason to keep dual boot. | New | 06, 16 |
| REQ-CMP-004 | The phone app and the glasses shall work against the Linux PC exactly as against the Windows PC. | New | 12 |
| REQ-OPS-001 | Updates shall be offered, not forced; applied atomically; and reversible by choosing the previous deployment at boot. | Planned (bootc) | 14 |
| REQ-OPS-002 | A documented recovery path shall reach a working desktop and his data from a USB stick, without MIA and without the network. | New | 14 |
| REQ-DX-003 | Building the OS image shall be one command from the repository, reproducible on another machine. | Planned | 15 |
| REQ-UX-002 | The essential functions (talk to MIA, search, Home, notifications, settings, the conventional desktop, power) shall each be one action away from anywhere in MIA's session. | Partial (web shell sidebar and Talk; desktop switch planned) | 10 |
| REQ-UX-005 | Information shall be shown with its source and age wherever a fact could be stale (readings, prices, finds). | Partial | 10 |
| REQ-UX-010 | Ambient mode shall never take focus, play sound or cover work except for an alarm, an urgent message or the person addressing MIA. | Partial (gate urgency levels; PC ambient surface New) | 10 |
| REQ-UX-011 | Workspace mode shall work fully without MIA's intelligence: files, apps, settings and the terminal behave as on any Linux desktop. | Planned | 10 |
| REQ-UX-020 | MIA's session shall be the default at login on the PC, and the conventional session one choice away on the same screen. | Planned | 10, 14 |

| REQ-UX-023 | From MIA's session, the conventional desktop, settings, a terminal and the system's troubleshooting tools shall be reachable without MIA answering. | New | 10 |

| REQ-DEV-005 | Each device shall report its capabilities (screen, voice, camera, model size) and MIA shall offer only what that device can do, saying where the rest is. | Partial (parity per device; capability report New) | 12 |

| REQ-HW-002 | The chosen Linux base shall have working GPU compute for the RX 7900 XTX with the model runner MIA uses, proven before the switch. | New | 06 |
| REQ-HW-004 | On hardware below a capability's needs, MIA shall say what's missing and offer the nearest working alternative (a smaller model, the PC's model, a screen instead of voice). | Partial | 07, 12 |

| REQ-HW-007 | MIA OS shall run its MVP on configuration 3 (the reference PC) with no hardware added. | New | 06 |
| REQ-HW-012 | With the GPU unavailable, MIA shall answer with a smaller model on the CPU or another node, and say so. | Partial (the phone falls back to the PC) | 06 |

| REQ-HW-022 | Losing any node (model node, Pi, phone) shall leave the others working, with the work it did placed elsewhere or said to be waiting. | Partial | 12 |
| REQ-HW-029 | A conversation he's in shall never wait behind background model work for more than one model load. | Partial (homeostasis defers) | 06 |

| REQ-INT-016 | The private journal and private-mode turns shall never enter the recall index unless he includes them. | New | 07, 13 |
| REQ-AGT-024 | System changes shall go only through the fixed-operation helper, each confirmed in the OS's own dialog. | New (PoC 5) | 08 |

| REQ-DSK-003 | The shell's layout shall work from 1280×720 to ultrawide without horizontal scrolling, collapsing the sidebar and moving Talk over the main area below 1280 px. | Partial (two columns at 1600 px) | 10, 11 |
| REQ-DSK-007 | The launcher shall list conventional Linux applications from the system's desktop entries, marked as such, without adding them to MIA's registry. | Planned | 10 |
| REQ-DSK-009 | Every search result shall be typed open, find, ask, start or do, and a do or start result shall only ever open an approval card. | Partial (action types) | 10 |
| REQ-DSK-011 | MIA shall read another window, a file or a selection only when he shares it, through the system's portal, each share shown as a chip that one press removes. | Partial (UAL selection) | 10, 13 |

| REQ-DSK-023 | MIA's Settings shall open the matching KDE System Settings page for each system setting, never a copy of it. | Planned | 10 |
| REQ-DSK-025 | Whenever the microphone or camera is in use by MIA, the shell shall show it, and one press shall close the stream. | Partial | 10, 13 |

| REQ-VIS-011 | No animation shall delay or block input, and every animation shall be interruptible. | Partial | 11 |
